original_text: Xu~et~al.~\cite{xu2019gin} introduced the Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN), establishing a theoretical link between GNN expressiveness and the Weisfeiler--Leman graph isomorphism test.
injected_text: Xu~et~al.~\cite{xu2019gin} introduced the Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN), establishing a theoretical link between GNN expressiveness and spectral graph theory.
rationale: The edit mis-attributes the foundational methodology of the cited GIN paper by replacing the Weisfeiler-Leman spatial isomorphism test with spectral graph theory, acting as a realistic categorical swap that directly contradicts the paper's actual framework.
ground_truth_description: The claim regarding Xu et al. (2019) was altered to incorrectly state that its theoretical foundation links GNN expressiveness to spectral graph theory instead of the Weisfeiler-Leman graph isomorphism test.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: Xu~et~al.~\cite{xu2019gin} introduced the Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN), establishing a theoretical link between GNN expressiveness and the Weisfeiler--Leman graph isomorphism test.
